series.name: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) - battery and EPS faults
series.notes: Battery-facing alarms. The Buck and Boost entries are MOSFET stage failures and are workshop items, not site items. CORRECTION to an earlier draft: the H1 V1.6 table DOES list both 'Bat Relay Open' and 'Bat Relay Short Circuit' (p.42) - an earlier claim that they were KH/KA-and-H3-only was wrong and has been removed. They are not expanded as separate entries here only because of the code-count budget; the verified strings are 'The battery relay keeps open' and 'The battery relay keeps close', both with the same disconnect/reconnect remedy, and both appear on H1, KH/KA and H3.

title.ur: Battery voltage normal range se bahar

meaning.en: The battery terminal voltage seen by the inverter is outside its acceptable window.
meaning.ur: Inverter jo battery terminal voltage dekh raha hai woh uski ijazat window se bahar hai.

causes.en: Battery deeply discharged and unable to charge because PV output is too low.
causes.ur: Battery poori tarah discharge ho chuka hai aur charge nahi ho sakta kyunke PV output bohat kam hai.

causes.en: BMS has cut the pack, or the pack's cell group is imbalanced.
causes.ur: BMS ne pack cut kar diya, ya pack ke cells ka group imbalanced hai.

causes.en: Battery voltage window set too wide for the pack actually installed.
causes.ur: Battery voltage window installed pack ke liye bohat chota set kiya gaya hai.

causes.en: Faulty battery voltage sensing harness between inverter and pack.
causes.ur: Inverter aur pack ke darmiyan battery voltage sensing wiring kharabi hai.

solutions.en: Measure battery voltage at the inverter's battery terminals with a multimeter and compare it to the pack's allowed range.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se inverter ke battery terminals par voltage napen aur pack ki ijazat range se compare karein.

solutions.en: Confirm the pack's SOC in FoxCloud; a deeply discharged pack normally needs PV generation to recover, not a reset.
solutions.ur: FoxCloud mein pack ka SOC confirm karein; bohat discharge hua pack reset nahi, PV generation chahta hai.

solutions.en: Check every battery inter-pack communication and power connector for a pushed-back pin.
solutions.ur: Har battery inter-pack communication aur power connector mein pin piche dhakeli hui to check karein.

notes.en: If a BMS code such as 'BMS Lost' or 'Bms Ext Fault' is also on screen, treat the pack as the primary suspect - see Series 6.
notes.ur: Agar screen par 'BMS Lost' ya 'Bms Ext Fault' jaisa code bhi hai to pack ko hi pehla mamool maanein - Series 6 dekhein.

source.title: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) Series User Manual V1.6, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

meaning.en: The pack is too empty to support the requested discharge; the inverter limits or blocks output to protect the battery.
meaning.ur: Pack itni khali hai ke maangi gayi discharge ko support nahi kar sakti; inverter battery bachane ke liye output kam ya band kar deta hai.

causes.en: Sustained cloudy weather, or a load that outruns the PV array.
causes.ur: Lambi musamlat ke baadal, ya aisa load jo PV array se tez chal raha hai.

causes.en: Grid outage lasting long enough to drain the pack to its floor.
causes.ur: Grid outage itna lamba ke pack apni floor tak khaali ho gaya.

causes.en: Parallel battery pack not communicating, so only part of the stored energy is usable.
causes.ur: Parallel battery pack communicate nahi kar raha, is liye sirf mukhtasar stored energy hi istemal hoti hai.

solutions.en: Wait for the battery to recharge, as FoxESS states; reduce discretionary load to let PV surplus go to the pack.
solutions.ur: Jaise FoxESS kahe battery ko recharge hone dein; gharelu load kam karein taake PV ka zyada hissa battery mein jaye.

solutions.en: Read the pack's SOC and the per-pack voltages in FoxCloud to confirm every parallel pack is being seen.
solutions.ur: FoxCloud mein pack ka SOC aur har pack ka voltage padhein taake confirm ho ke har parallel pack nazar aa raha hai.

solutions.en: If SOC is normal but the code persists, have the pack's BMS state-of-health read on site.
solutions.ur: Agar SOC normal hai lekin code qataar nahi hota to pack ka BMS state-of-health site par check karwayein.

notes.en: Common on Pakistani systems after a long load-shedding window. Frequently misreported by owners as 'inverter dead' when the unit is actually protecting the battery correctly.
notes.ur: Lambi load shedding ke baad Pakistan ke systems par ye aam hai. Log isay aksar 'inverter kharab' keh dete hain jabke unit asal mein battery bacha raha hai.

source.title: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) Series User Manual V1.6, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

title.ur: Battery buck circuit ka MOSFET kharab

meaning.en: The MOSFET in the inverter's battery buck stage has failed, so the inverter cannot regulate battery current.
meaning.ur: Inverter ke battery buck stage ka MOSFET kharab ho gaya, is liye inverter battery current regulate nahi kar sakta.

causes.en: Internal semiconductor failure, often from a prior over-current or thermal event.
causes.ur: Aam tor par semiconductor ki internal kharabi, jo aksar pichli over-current ya thermal event se hoti hai.

causes.en: Repeated battery over-current trips that stressed the stage.
causes.ur: Baar baar battery over-current trip hona jis ne stage ko stress diya.

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery completely and leave the unit isolated.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery poori tarah disconnect kar ke unit ko isolate hi chhor dein.

solutions.en: Do not attempt to power-cycle repeatedly; each attempt runs current through a failed device.
solutions.ur: Baar baar power-cycle na karein; har koshish failed device se current guzarta hai.

solutions.en: Log the fault code and serial number and raise a warranty/depot claim for the power board.
solutions.ur: Fault code aur serial number note karke power board ke liye warranty ya depot claim raise karein.

notes.en: Not a site-repairable item. Anything involving opening the inverter is licensed-electrician work.
notes.ur: Yeh site par theek nahi ho sakta. Inverter kholna kisi bhi licensed electrician ka kaam hai.

source.title: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) Series User Manual V1.6, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

title.ur: Battery boost circuit ka MOSFET kharab

meaning.en: The MOSFET in the inverter's battery boost stage has failed, so the inverter cannot raise battery voltage to the bus.
meaning.ur: Inverter ke battery boost stage ka MOSFET kharab ho gaya, is liye inverter battery voltage bus tak nahi barha sakta.

causes.en: Internal semiconductor failure, commonly after a battery surge or short.
causes.ur: Internal semiconductor kharabi, jo aksar battery surge ya short ke baad hoti hai.

causes.en: The battery-side relay in the inverter has not closed, which the H3 manual lists as an alternative cause of this same code.
causes.ur: Inverter ka battery side relay close nahi hua - H3 manual isi code ki doosri wajah yahi batata hai.

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery completely as FoxESS directs.
solutions.ur: Jaise FoxESS kahe AC, PV aur battery poori tarah disconnect karein.

solutions.en: Have a technician confirm the battery-side relay actually closes when commanded, before condemning the MOSFET.
solutions.ur: Technician se confirm karwayein ke command par battery-side relay asal mein close hota hai, phir MOSFET ko blame karein.

solutions.en: Update master firmware before reassessment - the H3 manual states a Boost fault on master below 1.69 can be a firmware artefact.
solutions.ur: Dobara dekhne se pehle master firmware update karein - H3 manual kehta hai ke 1.69 se neeche master par Boost fault firmware ka artifact ho sakta hai.

notes.en: H3 adds an explicit firmware caveat to this code; H1's table does not. Keep the two model lines separate - see CONFLICTS.
notes.ur: H3 is code par firmware ki explicit shart add karta hai; H1 ki table nahi karti. Dono model lines alag rakhein - CONFLICTS dekhein.

source.title: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) Series User Manual V1.6, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

title.ur: Battery connection ki polarity ulti hai

meaning.en: The battery positive and negative conductors are connected the wrong way round.
meaning.ur: Battery ke positive aur negative conductor ulat de mein lage hue hain.

causes.ur: Pehli commissioning par installer ki galti.

causes.en: Battery replaced or re-wired by a non-installer and polarity crossed.
causes.ur: Battery kisi non-installer ne badli ya rewired ki aur polarity badal gayi.

solutions.en: Open the battery DC isolator before touching any conductor.
solutions.ur: Kisi bhi conductor ko haath lagane se pehle battery DC isolator kholein.

solutions.en: With the battery isolated and pack disconnected, confirm polarity with a multimeter on the inverter's battery port before reconnecting.
solutions.ur: Battery isolate aur pack disconnect kar ke, wapas lagane se pehle multimeter se inverter ke battery port par polarity confirm karein.

solutions.en: Never energise the battery port to 'test' polarity - the BMS or the pack will be damaged.
solutions.ur: Polarity 'test' karne ke liye battery port ko kabhi energize na karein - BMS ya pack kharab ho jayega.

notes.en: Do NOT alias 'Bat Relay Short Circuit' to this. FoxESS lists that string as its own separate row, meaning 'The battery relay keeps close' - a welded-stuck relay, not reversed polarity. It is a different fault with a different meaning. See foxess-h3-ac3-power-relay for the verified H3 wording.
notes.ur: 'Bat Relay Short Circuit' ko is code ka alias na banayein. FoxESS us string ko apni alag row mein likhta hai, matlab 'The battery relay keeps close' - yani relay jam gaya, polarity ulti nahi. Yeh alag fault hai, alag matlab hai. Verified H3 wording ke liye foxess-h3-ac3-power-relay dekhein.

source.title: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) Series User Manual V1.6, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

meaning.en: The load connected to the backup/EPS output exceeds the inverter's off-grid power limit.
meaning.ur: Backup/EPS output se juda load inverter ki off-grid power limit se upar chala gaya.

causes.en: Motor-based load (pump, compressor, blower) with high inrush current on the EPS output.
causes.ur: Motor wala load (pump, compressor, blower) jis ka EPS output par inrush current zyada hai.

causes.en: Multiple high-starting appliances switching on together after a grid outage.
causes.ur: Grid outage ke baad ek saath kai high-inrush appliances on ho jana.

causes.en: EPS output wired with too small a cable, causing a voltage drop that counts as overload.
causes.ur: EPS output choti cable se jura ho, jis se voltage drop hokar overload ke tor par report hota hai.

solutions.en: List every EPS-connected load and sum the running power; keep it under the inverter's EPS rating.
solutions.ur: EPS se jude tamam loads likhein aur chalne wali power ka jama karein; usay inverter ki EPS rating se neeche rakhein.

solutions.en: Stagger large motor starts so they do not energise simultaneously.
solutions.ur: Bade motors ka start aise stagger karein ke wo ek saath on na hon.

solutions.en: If EPS trips under a load well within rating, check EPS cable size and the EPS connector for heat damage.
solutions.ur: Agar rating se andar wala load par EPS trip kare to EPS cable size aur EPS connector ka garm hone ka nuqsan check karein.

notes.en: Keep apart from 'Over Load Fault', which is the ON-grid equivalent. Owners routinely confuse the two; only this one has anything to do with backup output.
notes.ur: 'Over Load Fault' se alag rakhein - woh ON-grid wohi hai. Log dono ghalat karte hain; sirf ye backup output se related hai.

source.title: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) Series User Manual V1.6, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

meaning.en: The relay that transfers the load between grid and EPS output has failed.
meaning.ur: Load ko grid aur EPS output ke darmiyan transfer karne wala relay kharab ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Relay coil or contact failure after many transfer operations.
causes.ur: Bohat se transfer operations ke baad relay coil ya contact ki kharabi.

causes.en: Relay chattering during frequent grid outages, wearing the contacts.
causes.ur: Bari tarah se grid outages mein relay ka chatter karna, jis se contacts ghis jate hain.

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery completely before any work on the EPS wiring.
solutions.ur: EPS wiring par kaam karne se pehle AC, PV aur battery poori tarah disconnect karein.

solutions.en: Check whether the relay clicks when a grid outage is simulated by switching the AC breaker off and on.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke AC breaker off-on karke grid outage simulate karne par relay click karta hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Persistent fault means the relay assembly needs replacement - log the code and raise a service claim.
solutions.ur: Code qataar na ho to relay assembly badalna hoga - code note karke service claim raise karein.

notes.en: On a grid-unstable supply like Pakistan's, transfer-relay wear is a known high-incidence item on older hybrid units.
notes.ur: Pakistan jaisi grid-unstable supply par purane hybrid units par transfer-relay ki wear aam baat hai.

source.title: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) Series User Manual V1.6, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)
